name: All-Clad Stainless Half Sheet
description: All-Clad 11.5 by 17 inch stainless half sheet. The brand page and the Amazon listing describe tri-ply stainless steel bonded with aluminum, a polished stainless interior, and an oven and broiler limit of 600°F. Neither page uses the word PFAS.
features: Amazon ASIN B0GGJY5QFQ is titled as the 11.5 by 17 inch half sheet. The listing model number is J309S264. It says the pan is made by bonding stainless steel with aluminum, with a polished stainless interior, and that it is oven and broiler safe to 600°F. Hand washing is recommended.
All-Clad's page for the 11.5 by 17 inch half sheet lists model J3097464 and the same construction, interior, and 600°F line. The two model numbers are not the same string.
The pages checked do not name a nonstick coating and do not use the word PFAS. This directory has not tested the pan.
labelNote: The food-contact surface the pages name is polished stainless steel. No PFAS sentence was on the brand page or the Amazon listing checked November 27, 2026.
